purpose: Prevent duplicate feature/model rebuilds while separating Practice-006 scratch research from Practice-007 official algorithmic execution.

constraints: may not be treated as proof for 007 by itself
losses and rejected setups are evidence
do not import 006 behavior unless implemented as code and checkpointed
execution remains bound by existing governance/authorization contracts
do not duplicate canonical feature implementations

currency_strength_and_rank.reuse_rule: Use these before adding any new currency strength or relative-strength feature.
currency_strength_and_rank.duplicate_guard: Already done: currency strength, relative strength, rank, strength gaps, and strong-vs-weak pair expressions. Before adding any new field, map it to this family and document why the existing canonical source does not cover it.

rolling_technical_and_move_quality.reuse_rule: Extend only if the existing registry lacks a specific measured behavior; otherwise consume current columns.

conditional_patterns.reuse_rule: Research-only conditional archetypes; do not wire to 007 until validated and promoted through governance.

news_currency_mapping.reuse_rule: Do not create another news-to-pair mapper without proving this path is insufficient.

execution_cost_gates.reuse_rule: All 006/007 candidates must remain cost-aware; do not loosen after the all-negative fill history without evidence.

current_live_policy.account_006_runner: v15_low_candle_pressure_score_250; scratch paper runner with post-candle quote refresh, strict freshness/cost gates, score gate 250, and loss controls after all-negative selected fills
current_live_policy.account_007_policy: official best bot; algorithmic/model/code-only; keep as-is unless promoted reproducible logic consumes canonical deduplicated features
